action.new:
Exception raised when a nonblank, non-comment line is treated as a
   continuation of an option with no value. Continuation depends on
   indentation deeper than the preceding option and the configured
   blank-line and comment handling. This applies when the
   *allow_no_value* constructor argument is ``True``. Subclass of
   :exc:`ParsingError`. The offending line is retained exactly,
   including its original line ending when present.
action.old:
Exception raised when a continuation line (a line beginning with
   whitespace) follows an option that has no value.  This condition is
   only possible when :attr:`!allow_no_value` is ``True``.  Subclass of
   :exc:`ParsingError`.
